name: Supabase
rationale: Supabase apps need explicit browser/server client separation to prevent service-role keys and server-only helpers from leaking into UI code.

sources.label: Supabase client boundary
sources.note: Rules encode browser anon client versus server/service-role client separation.

directories.purpose: Supabase clients, typed helpers, and server-only access wrappers.

fileRules.name: Server/client Supabase split
fileRules.rule: Browser Supabase clients and service-role/server clients must live behind separate modules.
fileRules.trigger: A client component imports a service-role or server-only Supabase helper.
fileRules.recommendation: Create separate browser and server Supabase modules, and only import server modules from server-only code.
fileRules.goodExample: client.ts exposes browser-safe anon client; server.ts owns service-role access.

moduleBoundaries: Service-role keys must only be referenced in server-only modules.
Auth/session helpers should be centralized rather than reimplemented per route.
testingExpectations: Auth-dependent flows should have tests for logged-out, logged-in, and unauthorized states.
agentInstructions: Do not expose service-role keys or server-only Supabase helpers to client components.
